sql: SELECT customer_zip, SUM(amount) AS total_sales FROM analytics.fct_orders GROUP BY customer_zip
SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_zip, o.amount FROM analytics.fct_orders o WHERE o.status = 'complete'
SELECT customer_zip, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fct_orders GROUP BY customer_zip
SELECT customer_id, customer_zip, amount FROM analytics.fct_orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01'
SELECT ship_state, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM analytics.fct_orders WHERE customer_zip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ship_state
SELECT c.customer_segment, SUM(f.amount) AS revenue FROM analytics.fct_orders f JOIN analytics.dim_customer c ON f.customer_zip = c.customer_zip GROUP BY c.customer_segment
SELECT order_date, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM analytics.fct_orders GROUP BY order_date
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM analytics.fct_orders GROUP BY status
SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS lifetime_value FROM analytics.fct_orders GROUP BY customer_id
SELECT customer_zip FROM analytics.fct_orders f JOIN analytics.dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
